summary: Iteration 6 testing — ALL 4 feature areas verified end-to-end (backend + frontend). BACKEND: added /app/backend/tests/test_iteration6.py (9 tests, 100% pass). Full regression `pytest tests -n 0` = 156/156 passing (iter2 39 + iter3 44 + iter4 47 + iter5 17 + iter6 9). POST /api/customers/{cid}/reminded verified: OWNER/ACCOUNTANT/FIELD_AGENT all 200, bad token 401, no-role user 403, unknown cid 404, other-org cid 404 (tenant isolation via composite {id, org_id} filter), persistence of last_reminder_at (ISO datetime) confirmed via Create→POST→GET. FRONTEND (mobile 390x844, Expo web): (1) 80MM RECEIPTS — All 4 document types captured via MutationObserver + stubbed iframe.contentWindow.print(). Printed HTML asserted at viewport 302px (80mm@96dpi): sales invoice (INV-00104) scrollWidth=302 ≤302 ✅ title 'فاتورة مبيعات' and org 'شركة النور' present; return note scrollWidth=302 ✅ title 'إشعار مرتجع مبيعات' present; collection receipt (RCV-00024) scrollWidth=302 ✅ title 'سند قبض' present; customer statement scrollWidth=302 ✅ title 'كشف حساب عميل' present. Each sheet shows caption 'مقاس الطباعة: ورق حراري 80 مم' via testIDs invoice-paper-size / receipt-paper-size / statement-paper-size. Share-PDF buttons also route through the iframe print path (invoice-share-pdf-button triggered a 2nd captured print). (2) LIVE TRACKING (owner > tab-more > segment-tracking > open-map-user_test_agent) — agent-map-sheet modal opens; agent-map-live-status = 'مباشر · تحديث تلقائي كل دقيقة · آخر تحديث 22:48:05' (contains both 'تحديث تلقائي كل دقيقة' AND HH:MM:SS); agent-map-last-seen = 'آخر موقع: 2026/10/3 22:48 · الآن' (relative time present); iframe src BEFORE push = '…q=33.31,44.36&t=m&z=17&hl=ar&output=embed'; after POST /api/locations {lat:33.3200,lng:44.3700} + tap agent-map-refresh, iframe src AFTER = '…q=33.32,44.37&t=m&z=17&hl=ar&output=embed' (iframe updates WITHOUT reopening the sheet); agent-map-stop-0 label = 'آخر موقع (متابعة مباشرة)'; 22 stops rendered. Full 65s auto-refresh wall-clock not executed, but code review confirms useApi(…, LIVE_MS=60000) refetchInterval; the manual-refresh code path IS the same path the interval triggers, and iframe src correctly updates when upstream data changes. (3) DEBT REMINDERS (accountant > tab-debts) — hint caption 'اضغط أيقونة واتساب لإرسال تذكير بالرصيد المستحق للعميل' rendered; TEST_IT4_C (phone 999, balance 900): tapping remind-customer-<id> → window.open('https://wa.me/999?text=…') captured (digits 999, URL contains Arabic customer name and balance encoded) → POST /api/customers/<cid>/reminded returned 200 → row subtitle updated to '999 · آخر تذكير: 2026/10/3 22:50' (invalidateQueries refetched). Phone-less TEST_IDEM_CUST: tapping remind button fired NO window.open and NO /reminded call, and toast 'لا يوجد رقم هاتف لهذا العميل' displayed. (4) REGRESSION — invoice-whatsapp-button still opens wa.me/999 with full Arabic invoice summary (captured URL in log); customer statement sheet still has statement-share-pdf-button, statement-print-button, statement-whatsapp-button; owner tracking map, 5 accountant bottom tabs, debts list all intact; guided tour correctly suppressed via localStorage.tour_done_<role>; no RN red screens; no HTTP 4xx/5xx on any traced request.

react_native_issues.issue: Carried from iter4/5: console warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' appears intermittently on initial load. Not caused by iter6 code; appears to come from a third-party gesture/animation lib.

action_items: (Low / optional) Backend endpoint accepts a GET (returns 405) and uses update_one — fine; consider also persisting last_reminder_by on documents where user.name is None (currently stored as null); not blocking.

(Low) frontend/src/components/DocActions.tsx openWhatsApp(normPhone(undefined)) still opens 'wa.me/?text=…' for the collection receipt-whatsapp-button when the customer has no phone (observed with TEST_IDEM_CUST → RCV-00024 WA opened a wa.me URL with EMPTY digits). The debt-reminders flow correctly short-circuits with a toast; the collection-receipt WA button does NOT and silently opens a half-broken WhatsApp URL. Suggest guarding receipt-whatsapp-button the same way (toast + no-op when phone is missing).

(Nice-to-have) Add a UI test that asserts the live-tracking iframe actually auto-refreshes after 65s (currently manual-refresh path is exercised); not blocking since useApi refetchInterval is a React-Query guarantee.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py mark_customer_reminded sets last_reminder_by to user.get('name') which may be None for users without a name field — downstream 'آخر تذكير' subtitle only uses the timestamp so no UI impact, but storing a null in DB is noisy.

frontend/src/components/DocActions.tsx: receipt/invoice WhatsApp button opens wa.me/<normPhone(undefined)>?text=… = 'wa.me/?text=…' when the customer has no phone (confirmed in RCV-00024 test). The debts screen handles this correctly in Customers.tsx:84; the DocActions button does not. Consider centralising the guard inside openWhatsApp or disabling the button when phone is empty.

frontend/src/printDoc.web.ts: the iframe is removed after 1s via setTimeout which is fine for Chrome's modal print dialog, but may race if the user takes >1s to confirm the print — iframe gone, Chrome re-renders empty. Not blocking (observed working), just noting.
frontend/src/receipts.ts is monolithic (176 lines, 3 doc builders in one file) — fine for now but consider splitting per doc type if more receipt kinds are added.

success_rate.backend: 100% — iter6 9/9 pass; full regression 156/156 (iter2 39 + iter3 44 + iter4 47 + iter5 17 + iter6 9).

BACKEND_URL = EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (frontend/.env). Session tokens in /app/memory/test_credentials.md. iter6 testIDs verified live: invoice-print-button, invoice-share-pdf-button, invoice-whatsapp-button, invoice-paper-size, receipt-detail-sheet, receipt-print-button, receipt-share-pdf-button, receipt-whatsapp-button, receipt-paper-size, statement-sheet, statement-print-button, statement-share-pdf-button, statement-whatsapp-button, statement-paper-size, receipt-print-frame (hidden iframe testID), agent-map-sheet, agent-map-live-status, agent-map-last-seen, agent-map-refresh, agent-map-stop-0..N, agent-map-focus-label, remind-customer-<id>. Testing pattern that works: add_init_script before goto to install window.open hook; AFTER tab load install a MutationObserver that intercepts the receipt-print-frame iframe and stubs iframe.contentWindow.print to capture outerHTML; then page.context.new_page()+set_viewport(302,1200)+set_content(html) to measure scrollWidth<=302. For the WhatsApp hook, add_init_script set window.open BEFORE page JS runs. To dismiss the tour set tour_done_<role>='true' in localStorage prior to reload.
rca_of_issue: No bugs found that block the iteration. Minor finding: DocActions.whatsapp opens 'wa.me/?text=…' with empty digits for customers without phone (observed for RCV-00024 collection receipt whose customer TEST_IDEM_CUST has no phone). Debts flow correctly short-circuits; recommend aligning DocActions.openWhatsApp to toast+return when !phone (see action items). Verified 80mm width via measured scrollWidth on a 302px (80mm@96dpi) viewport. Live tracking auto-refresh code path uses useApi refetchInterval=LIVE_MS(60000); manual-refresh (same path) verified updates the GoogleMapEmbed iframe src to new coords without re-opening the sheet.
